## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Phoenix, United States. It starts at 5000 S Arizona Mills Circle, Suite 135.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Hoppy the tarantula, Lancelot the snake, Mojave the tortoise – not the cast of a Pixar movie, rather the cast of SEA LIFE Arizona's Critter Canyon.
>
> SEA LIFE Arizona isn't just an aquarium, although sharks, rays, and fish are all here! Face your fears around snakes, spiders, and more with up-close encounters. See endangered and rehabilitated wildlife, and watch graceful sea creatures in motion, like seahorses, clownfish, jellyfish, and sea turtles. You can also catch feeding demonstrations!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.76. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 40 ratings and 14 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
